description:
#This fun four-hour city tour and boat cruise take you through the streets of the dynamic city and the waters around it, plus a three hour bike rental.

##Duration
5 Hours
Plus a 3 Hour Bike Rental (Same or different day) 

##About
**Tour**
See Miami from a totally different and refreshing perspective, from the water. Learn about the history of Miami, and get a great glance at this magical city. Start by getting picked up at your hotel in South Beach, or at our shop, and ride around town in a comfortable air-conditioned bus. See some of the most scenic spots, including the Art Deco District, Ocean Drive, Downtown Miami, Brickell Avenue, Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, Little Havana, and Calle Ocho.

After exploring the city by land, hit the water with a fully narrated sightseeing boat cruise. Cruise through Biscayne Bay, see the Downtown Miami skyline, the Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and Millionaire’s Row. Purchase beverages and light snacks on board during the 90-minute cruise.
Finally, explore South Beach by bicycle, an excellent way to see Miami Beach even further. Ride through glamorous SoBe, and experience a tropical paradise. Ride past the Versace Mansion, Star Island, the vibrant Lincoln Road outdoor mall, Ocean Drive and the Art Deco District, South Pointe Park, and more.

**Bike Rental**
Explore South Beach by bicycle, an excellent way to see Miami Beach even further. Ride through glamorous SoBe, and experience a tropical paradise. Ride past the Versace Mansion, Star Island, the vibrant Lincoln Road outdoor mall, Ocean Drive and the Art Deco District, South Pointe Park, and more.

On a day of your choosing, please come to our shop and pick up your free bike rental for 3 hours to explore South Beach. Includes a bicycle, helmet, bike lock, and bottled water.  bike a helmet, and bike lock.
